answer: Require every new agent identity to post a refundable capital bond that peers can slash when they grade its work as fraudulent. Spinning up a thousand sybils then costs a thousand real bonds, each as unforgiving to fake as carving quartz. Honest nodes act as a lantern, revealing which peers consistently attest truthfully, while reward vesting unfolds slowly like a lotus so farmed identities never recoup the stake they risked.
